entries.prompt: PETOPIA reusable foreground decoration KIT, transparent PNG, 3 columns by 2 rows, six fully separated props with wide transparent gutter. Match attached meadow reference's fine illustrated pixel clusters and rich dimensional shading, warm upper-left sunlight, crisp dark edges. Top row: (1) low broad flowering grassy mound, white daisies and warm pink flowers, mossy base, (2) a leafy berry shrub with red berries, lush broad leaves, low supporting grass roots, (3) small moss-covered irregular rock group with 3 white/yellow flowers rooted around base. Bottom row: (4) cascading irregular moss and roots growing DOWN a cliff, (5) different hanging broadleaf vine with blue-green dark shadows and a few pink blossoms, (6) short moss-covered fallen log and fern patch grounded on grass. These are small layered foreground accents for existing terrain, NOT complete landscapes or platform tiles. No dirt rectangles, no backgrounds, no characters, no UI, no text, no baked oval shadows. Each ground prop has a clear shared bottom contact line in its cell; hanging props attach at top. Different natural silhouettes, full volume, broad readable lit/shadow clusters instead of gritty noise. True transparent outside. Full props all inside cells, no clipping. Used beside42-worldpixel hero: flowering mound25pxwide, shrub30pxwide, vines12pxwide/22pxtall. Keep style unified with attached rock/grass, not generic flat icons.
